patches.name: organ2
patches.notes: THE M1 sound — ORGAN 2 (INT 17). The house-music organ of all time. Every Italo-house and early house track 1988-1994. Range c2-c6. Used in: Robin S 'Show Me Love', Black Box 'Ride on Time', Madonna 'Vogue', every classic house anthem. Probably the most-sampled digital preset in dance music history.

patches.name: universe-pad
patches.notes: UNIVERSE (PRES 88) — wide ethereal pad with shimmer + airy strings layer. Range c2-c6. Used in: Enya productions, ambient electronica, 90s film scores, Soul II Soul backing pads.

patches.name: piano-16
patches.notes: PIANO 16 — M1's stock electric piano. Soft Rhodes-ish character. Range a1-a5. Used in: 80s/90s pop ballads, all over R&B productions that needed a pad-piano hybrid.

patches.name: fretless-bass
patches.notes: FRETLESS BASS (INT 23) — smooth jazz fretless impression. Mwah character. Range a1-a3. Used in: smooth jazz, 90s R&B ballads, Babyface productions.

patches.name: slap-bass
patches.notes: SLAP BASS — the percussive slap-bass preset. Bright attack. Range a1-a3. Used in: 80s/90s funk-pop, Whitney Houston, Mariah Carey productions.

patches.name: strings-pad
patches.notes: STRINGS — M1's stock string pad. Lush, slow attack. Range c2-c6. Used in: house anthem backgrounds, R&B ballads, ambient productions.

patches.name: horn-section
patches.notes: HORN SECTION — brass stab patch. Bright, punchy. Range c3-c5. Used in: 90s R&B, hip-hop soul productions, Mary J Blige era.

patches.name: fantasia
patches.notes: FANTASIA — bell + pad layer, vector-synth movement. Range c3-c6. Used in: 80s/90s ambient pop, soundtracks, Enya-adjacent productions.

patches.name: vocal-pad
patches.notes: VOCAL PAD — voice-like pad with formants. Range c3-c6. Used in: house anthem 'aaah' pads, R&B background swells.

patches.name: marimba
patches.notes: MARIMBA — woody mallet sample. Range c2-c6. Used in: 80s/90s pop melodic hooks, jazz-pop productions.

patches.name: shaker-perc
patches.notes: SHAKER / TAMBOURINE percussion samples — useful one-shots for adding 80s/90s pop percussion. Range c3-c5.

patches.name: kicks-snares
patches.notes: M1's stock drum samples — kick, snare, hi-hat. Defined the 'M1 drums' sound that's on hundreds of house/R&B tracks. Range c1-c2 (drum-mapped). One-shot capture.
